map.干眼症 OSDI 自评量表提供标准 12 题问卷，计算总分与子维度分并分级，用于: The dry eye OSDI questionnaire provides the standard 12-item survey, computes the total and subdimension scores and grades them, for subjective dry eye symptom assessment and severity screening.
map.OSDI = (各题得分之和 × 100) / (已答题数 × 4): OSDI = (sum of item scores x 100) / (answered items x 4)
map.12 题按频率 0–4 计分，OSDI = 总分/(答题数×4)×100（0–1: The 12 items are scored 0-4 by frequency, with OSDI = total score / (answered items x 4) x 100 (0-100).
map.：OSDI = 18/(10×4)×100 = 45 分，属中重度干眼（≥33: OSDI = 18/(10 x 4) x 100 = 45 points, which is moderate to severe dry eye (33 and above is moderate to severe).
map.：OSDI = 8/(12×4)×100 ≈ 17，轻度干眼（12–22 为轻度: OSDI = 8/(12 x 4) x 100 = about 17, mild dry eye (12-22 is mild).
map.常分 0–11 正常、12–22 轻度、23–32 中度、≥33 重度（不同研究: Usually split as 0-11 normal, 12-22 mild, 23-32 moderate, 33 and above severe (studies vary slightly).
map.未答全如何算？: What if not all items are answered?
map.按实际答题数归一（总分/答题数×4×100），避免缺失偏倚。: Normalize by the number actually answered (total score / answered items x 4 x 100) to avoid missing-item bias.
